LYRICS ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

For the Lyric Block, input the costume you want to use in the first slot.
Then, put the duration you want this to be on screen for.

SYNCING ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

For syncing, you can use Events for when the character says something, and just put it in the [When I receive (EVENT)] block. Or, if there isn't a good way to time events, just use the [Wait (TIME) seconds] block below.

THE IMAGE ITSELF ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

Press the costumes tab and look for the costume called TUTORIAL!!
The rest of the info is there.
